title: CraftedInks
description: A simple datapack that allows crafting of black dye, ink sacs and leather
body:
# Ever had the pressing need to automate book production?
No? Well, I did.

## Introducing CraftedInks
Craft together 6 coal (or charcoal) with a bit of paper to produce 6 black dye.
Bind 6 black dye into a pouch with some paper, dried kelp, or leather to create an ink sac

There are some other recipies too - making string from wool, or leather from rotten flesh (in a furnace).

_But why are the recipies not efficient?_
I thought it was only fair that this easier method wasn't as effective as the vanilla one. But to be honest I just made this pack for my own server so, feel free to tweak it for your own :)
